title: How many times each letter of an archaic genome was read, 2010 to 2017 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the average fold coverage of archaic human genomes from the Leipzig group. The Vindija Neanderthal draft of 2010: 1.3. The Denisovan finger bone, 2010: 1.9. The same bone again, 2012: about 30. The Altai Neanderthal, 2014: 52. A Vindija Neanderthal, 2017: about 30.
heading: FOLD COVERAGE · LOG SCALE
